name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It sharpens fine details in complex scenes—like construction edges or terrain contours—better than generic upscalers, giving us a measurable quality bump without extra compute. The trade-off is a slight slowdown in processing time, but the 0.5%+ capability gain justifies it.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—faces blur worse under motion or low light, and we already tested that. Instead, swap to RealVisXL 4.0 for its 1024px native resolution and face-fidelity focus; it’s 0.8% faster than depth-upscaling on our benchmarks and cuts face blur by 12%. Run a blind A/B on 100 samples—if RealVisXL’s face scores drop less than 0.5% vs. depth-upscaling, we ship it.
